competitions.result: Third round — lost 1–0 away to Burnley.
Runners-up — lost 3–2 to Chelsea after extra time.
Champions League winners — beat AC Milan 3–2 on penalties after a 3–3 draw.

out.note: Left in May 2004 ahead of the new campaign.

overview: Liverpool won their fifth European Cup in Rafael Benítez’s first season after his arrival from Valencia. Trailing AC Milan 3–0 at half-time in Istanbul on 25 May, they drew level through Steven Gerrard, Vladimír Šmicer and Xabi Alonso before winning the penalty shoot-out 3–2.

Gerrard’s goal against Olympiacos had helped secure a place in the knockout stages, where Liverpool overcame Bayer Leverkusen, Juventus and Chelsea. Luis García scored the only goal of the semi-final tie against Chelsea. He, Gerrard and Milan Baroš shared the club’s scoring lead with 13 competitive goals each.

The domestic campaign brought fifth place in the Premier League with 58 points, three behind Everton. Chelsea beat Liverpool 3–2 after extra time in the League Cup final, while Burnley ended their FA Cup run in the third round. Alonso and García were among the new arrivals, and Michael Owen left for Real Madrid.
